name: Longest Night
source:
A mysterious traveller wakes up to find themselves in the icy domain of the cool-headed winter spirit Jack Frost, with no recollection at all of how they might have arrived there. 

Appearances can be deceptive, though, and soon it becomes clear that things may not be quite as innocent as they seem. Do your best to survive the night, okay?~<3
